market_wrap.text: Nifty fell 1.75% to 25,350 (Sensex −1,484 points) after a gap-up open reversed into broad selling. Profit-taking after a strong November rally, a roughly 93% market-implied chance of a December US Fed rate rise, a rupee near 93 per dollar and the global AI-stock sell-off weighed; banks and metals led the fall, with Tata Steel down about 8.5% on its APL Apollo deal, while IT stocks rose.

No company news found today. Indian AI-linked stocks including Netweb fell as the global AI sell-off deepened after the Nasdaq dropped over 5% on Friday; Indian IT services stocks rose, but Netweb trades with the AI-hardware theme rather than with them.
